news.title: Don’t issue completion certificates to buildings in aquifer zones: Madras HC tells GCC
news.para: The Madras High Court has mandated the Greater Chennai Corporation to impose strict regulations on Aquifer Recharge Zones, which include Kottivakkam, Palavakkam, and Uthandi. Construction activities in these areas will now be under vigilant scrutiny, highlighting the importance of following the Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules. A dedicated monitoring committee will be tasked with overseeing development and ensuring all future permits comply with these essential regulations.

news.title: Noida authority board adopts model building regulations to remove FAR cap
news.para: The Noida Authority has green-lighted the implementation of the Model Building Regulations, 2026, aimed at transforming urban landscapes. With the removal of the FAR cap for group housing along extensive 45-metre roadways, high-rise structures are set to gain momentum. Moreover, a master developer for the envisioned AI City-cum-Business Park will be appointed via competitive bidding.

news.title: Keralam orders vigilance probe into KIIFB land acquisition in Kannur
news.para: The Kerala government's Cabinet convened to decide on a thorough inquiry into the land acquisition practices of KIIFB. This probe stems from Chief Minister V D Satheesan's concerns raised within the Assembly. An expert panel highlighted issues related to the acquisition of almost 1,000 acres in Kannur, suggesting that the purchased land was unsuitable for construction and obtained at inflated rates.

news.title: ArisUnitern secures DaaS mandate for commercial project in Mumbai
news.para: ArisUnitern RE Solutions, a subsidiary of Arisinfra Solutions, has received an 18-month Developer-as-a-Service mandate from Transcon Group for the second phase of Transcon Ramdev Plaza in Santacruz West, Mumbai. The commercial project has an estimated GDV of ₹250 crore and about 56,000 sq ft of RERA carpet area available for free sale.

news.title: Madhya Pradesh draft housing policy puts affordable rentals near workplaces in focus
news.para: Madhya Pradesh's Chief Minister Mohan Yadav released a draft housing policy that focuses on affordable rental homes. The policy aims to target urban workers who earn between Rs 3 lakh and Rs 6 lakh annually. It includes provisions to develop housing near workplaces like hospitals and industrial clusters. Builders will receive incentives for creating these residential projects on public land.

news.title: Awfis adds 1.45 lakh sq ft workspace across Pune, Bengaluru & Mumbai
news.para: Awfis Space Solutions has added about 1.45 lakh sq ft of chargeable workspace across Pune, Bengaluru and Mumbai. Including its recently launched one lakh sq ft Elite centre in Delhi Aerocity, the company has added around 2.45 lakh sq ft of premium workspace across these launches.

news.title: UK homebuilders' shares slump as budget's first-time buyer scheme disappoints
news.para: Following Minister John Healey's introduction of the 'Your First Home' scheme, shares of British homebuilders plummeted. Although aimed at assisting new buyers, the plan's limited funding and slow implementation worries developers, who will also contend with unexpectedly high fees. Analysts predict that this funding will only support sales for a couple of years, leaving builders hesitant to initiate new projects due to reduced profitability.

news.title: Anant Raj's profit rises 13% to ₹156.49 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Anant Raj Ltd has proudly announced a 13 percent surge in its consolidated net profit for the quarter ending in September. The net profit escalated to Rs 156.49 crore, up from Rs 138.18 crore in the previous year. Total income for the quarter reached Rs 678.95 crore, a notable rise from Rs 640.89 crore. Over the last six months, the company recorded a net profit of Rs 305.

news.title: Omaxe  losses narrow to ₹25.55 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Omaxe Ltd has disclosed a consolidated net loss of Rs 25.55 crore for its September quarter, reflecting a noteworthy improvement from last year's loss of Rs 166.42 crore. The company reported a total income surge to Rs 613.91 crore for the second quarter, contributing to an impressive Rs 1,052.85 crore for the first half. Established in 1987, Omaxe remains a significant player in the real estate sector.

news.title: PNB Housing Finance’s net profit rises 6% to ₹616.55 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: For the quarter ending September 30, 2026, PNB Housing Finance has reported a six percent increase in net profit. The company's total income also experienced a notable rise of 13.8 percent, amounting to ₹2,423.95 crore. The loan assets witnessed a significant growth of 19 percent, especially in the affordable market segments. Meanwhile, gross non-performing assets improved to 0.91 percent, bolstering overall financial stability.

news.title: Arkade Developers’ net profit declines 46% to ₹24.80 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Arkade Developers reported a striking 45.9 percent drop in net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, with total income falling by 44.6 percent compared to the prior fiscal year. Notably, collections saw a 22 percent rise year-on-year, reaching ₹183 crore. In the first half of FY27, net profit declined by 41.1 percent alongside a 31.3 percent decrease in total income.

news.title: Embassy Office Parks REIT’s NOI rises 15% to ₹1,069 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Embassy REIT reported a robust performance for Q2 FY27, showing a 15 percent growth in net operating income, amounting to ₹1,069 crore. The operational revenue surged by 16 percent, hitting ₹1,303 crore. A distribution of ₹670.16 crore was declared by the board, marking a nine percent year-on-year increase. Moreover, the REIT successfully leased 1.

news.title: Kreeva plans ₹5,000 crore expansion; targets two residential projects annually
news.para: Kreeva plans to invest ₹5,000 crore in residential developments across Delhi-NCR within the next four to five years. This strategy includes launching two new projects each year, targeting both luxury and multi-generational housing. Following recent successes with the Swaranaya project in South Delhi and another venture in Gurugram, Kreeva is also exploring options in Chandigarh and Lucknow, emphasizing ultra-luxury housing in chosen markets.

news.title: Trehan IRIS invests ₹400 crore to develop Greater Noida West mall
news.para: Trehan IRIS plans to make IRIS Broadway Greno West operational in Q1 2027. The company is investing ₹400 crore in the retail component and another ₹135 crore in a 135-room Courtyard by Marriott hotel at the mixed-use development. The mall is targeting annual retail consumption of over ₹580 crore in its first year, rising to around ₹700 crore in the second year.

news.title: India real estate private equity investment falls 31% to $1.66 billion in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Private equity investment in Indian real estate declined 31% year-on-year to $1.66 billion during January-September 2026, even as the number of transactions increased to 31 from 24. Domestic investors accounted for 85% of total investment, compared with 25% a year earlier.

news.title: India retail leasing rises 19% to 5.8 million sq ft in January-September 2026: Report
news.para: Retail space absorption across India reached about 5.8 million sq ft during January-September 2026, up around 19% year-on-year. Delhi-NCR, Mumbai and Hyderabad together accounted for nearly 67% of total leasing, while new retail supply stood at about 1.8 million sq ft.

news.title: Allahabad HC orders demolition of illegal towers at Ghaziabad's Gulmohar Greens
news.para: The Allahabad High Court has delivered a major verdict in the case concerning illegal construction at Gulmohar Greens Society in Ghaziabad. The Court has directed the Ghaziabad Development Authority (GDA) to completely demolish illegal Towers 27 and 28 of the society.

news.title: Draw of lots for second-phase house allotment at Wayanad township on October 31
news.para: On Saturday, the draw of lots for house allotment in Wayanad township will be conducted for beneficiaries. A total of 149 houses are set to be allocated to survivors of the Mundakkai-Chooralmala landslide. Efforts are being made to ensure all necessary services are ready by November when the houses are handed over. Additionally, a study will address rainwater stagnation in the area and resolve drainage issues.

news.title: Pune: Townships forced to depend on polluted Mula water in Hinjewadi
news.para: Residents living in expansive housing developments near Hinjewadi IT Park are voicing their fears regarding the polluted water supplied from the river. Persistent complaints about discolored, yellow-tinted water have been reported, despite initiatives from local authorities. The Maharashtra Pollution Control Board is currently engaged in talks to find resolutions while acknowledging that untreated sewage significantly contributes to the travesty.

news.title: Krisala, Hiranandani Communities plan township in Nagpur; Mahindra Lifespaces signs JDA for 10.05-acre Bengaluru land
news.para: Krisala Developers has partnered with Hiranandani Communities to create a golf course township in Nagpur. This township will encompass plotted developments, townhouses, villas, and an integrated golf course. Additionally, Mahindra Lifespace Developers has formed a joint development agreement for land in North Bengaluru. This agreement includes planned residential apartments with an estimated gross development value of ₹1,250 crore.
